name: prestamos-desktop-monorepo
description: Monorepo para Sistema de Créditos Desktop (Electron + React + Spring Boot + SQLite)

scripts.build:backend: cd backend && .\mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests && powershell -Command "Copy-Item backend\target\*.jar dist-bin\backend.jar -Force"
